domain_restrictions: n is restricted to positive natural numbers
d ranges over all real numbers
x ranges over all real numbers
the implication premise restricts x to values equal to J_{n,j}(d)
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For all positive natural numbers n, for all integers j, for all real numbers d, H_{n,j}(d) equals F_n evaluated at J_{n,j}(d).
quantifier_order: for all positive natural number n

variables.name: n
variables.role: index for functions J and H (with parameter j) and index for function F

variables.name: j
variables.role: index parameter for functions J and H

variables.name: d
variables.role: input to functions J and H

variables.name: x
variables.role: variable constrained to equal J_{n,j}(d); input to function F_n

witness_dependencies: No existential witnesses are introduced; the statement is purely universal with an implication.
In the implication, x is dependent on n, j, and d through the condition x equals J_{n,j}(d).

statement_nl: For every positive natural number n, every integer j, every real d, and every real x, if x = J_{n,j}(d), then H_{n,j}(d) = F_n(x).
